headline: Stlican Shelf Contested as Weathered Expanse Slaughter Continues Unabated
war_summary: Fresh upheaval marks the latest field dispatches as Stlican Shelf erupts into renewed motion, logging three strategic base exchanges within the last two hours amidst sharply mounting casualties. Weathered Expanse continues to endure the heaviest fighting of the war, adding two further territorial transfers and over four thousand casualties across the two-hour span as the contest over Frostmarch and adjacent sectors grinds on unabated. In Linn of Mercy, the rapid base flips of earlier hours have stalled, though the meatgrinder grinds relentlessly with Warden casualties alone topping sixteen hundred in two hours. Fisherman's Row registered fresh exchanges earlier in the afternoon before settling, leaving the Wardens holding a single strategic redoubt against eight Colonial bases. Farther inland, static lines hold fast against immense pressure: Callahan's Passage swallowed more than thirty-three hundred casualties in two hours of accelerating fire, while Stonecradle and Mooring County absorbed heavy bilateral losses without yielding ground. Across these bloodied corridors, enlistment rosters swell as reinforcements rush to stabilize fractured defenses.
